rows.commentary: 5.5: Heather Graham serves it up to Amy Jones, who gently works the ball into the mid-wicket region for a single.
5.6: No run for Meg Lanning off Heather Graham.
6.1: Disaster for Amy Jones as Lauren Smith watches Lizelle Lee orchestrate a sharp run out, dismissing her for seven runs which included a solitary boundary.
6.2: Lauren Smith flights this delivery toward Annabel Sutherland, who pushes it firmly down to long-on for a brisk single.
6.3: Meg Lanning accepts the invitation from Lauren Smith, clipping the ball smartly towards fine leg to scamper back for a comfortable couple.
6.4: Meg Lanning does not score off Lauren Smith.
6.5: Meg Lanning does not score off Lauren Smith.
6.6: Meg Lanning does not score off Lauren Smith.
7.1: No run for Annabel Sutherland off Molly Strano.
7.2: Dot ball from Molly Strano to Annabel Sutherland.
7.3: Molly Strano loops this one up to Annabel Sutherland, who sweeps it away into the deep mid-wicket pocket for two rapid runs.
7.4: Annabel Sutherland reads Molly Strano early, driving it once more out toward deep mid-wicket to secure another pair of runs.
7.5: No run for Annabel Sutherland off Molly Strano.
7.6: Molly Strano completes her over as Annabel Sutherland steers the ball down to deep mid-wicket, rotating the strike with a single.
8.1: Heather Graham pitches it full to Annabel Sutherland, who lofts her shot out to long-on to comfortably pick up a single.
8.2: Heather Graham delivers to Meg Lanning, who eases the ball down to long-off for a straightforward rotation of the strike.
17.4: Heather Graham strikes to remove Annabel Sutherland lbw after a fine 57 featuring five boundaries and two sixes.
17.5: Heather Graham drops it into the turf as Kim Garth collects a single out toward deep mid-wicket.
17.6: Heather Graham is worked away by Danielle Gibson for a single directed down to long-off.
18.1: Dot ball from Lauren Smith to Danielle Gibson.
18.2: Lauren Smith keeps things tight as Danielle Gibson nudges the ball across to short mid-wicket for a quick single.
18.3: Lauren Smith watches Kim Garth sprint hard for three runs sent racing out to deep mid-wicket.
18.4: Lauren Smith fires one up and Danielle Gibson dispatches it brilliantly to the deep extra cover fence for four.
18.5: Lauren Smith induces a sharp clip off the pads from Danielle Gibson down to backward square leg for a single.
18.6: Lauren Smith bowls it full as Kim Garth works the delivery away into the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
19.1: Molly Strano slides it into Kim Garth, who works the ball neatly toward mid-wicket for a single.
19.2: Molly Strano delivers to Danielle Gibson, who scampers back for a sharp couple of runs out toward cover.
19.3: Danielle Gibson does not score off Molly Strano.
19.4: Molly Strano is launched into orbit by Danielle Gibson, clearing the deep mid-wicket boundary with ease for six.
19.5: Molly Strano drops it short and Danielle Gibson punishes it fiercely, carving the ball away to the deep mid-wicket fence for four.
19.6: Molly Strano pushes the final delivery through, finding Danielle Gibson who drives firmly out to long-off and scurries back frantically for the second run.
